label: close[i+2]>open[i+2], ties not up
features: Exact baseline3/all24, same order, warmup90 and per-fit median/IQR clipping as FEATURE-ABLATION-001. No removal/addition of columns.
training: Fixed models only; last365 mature feature examples j>=90,j+2<=test_start-2,min60. No adaptive updates. SGD10 lr.001,l2.01 reproduced as comparator; converged same-alpha and converged inner-selected-alpha.
objective: mean logistic loss + alpha/2*sum(nonintercept_weights**2). Newton/Armijo max100iterations gradient_inf<1e-8, Armijo with 4*machine_epsilon rounding allowance; abort if final gradient_inf>1e-7 or train maxabslogit>=35. Outer converged fits verified by SciPy L-BFGS-B numerical jac, objective difference<=1e-9 and coefficient difference<=1e-4.
selection: Three alphas per feature set and outer block. Observation-weighted inner log_loss, two prior folds. Tie smaller alpha. Prefix-only selector. Freeze both selections before external evaluation.
controls: converged same alpha .01 isolates optimizer effect
historical prior (ups+1)/(n+2) from same mature training labels
primary_metric: log_loss; all blocks and pooled observation-weighted results, no winner selection by test
secondary_metrics: all selected params and convergence audits
uncertainty: Selected-vs-SGD10,vs.5,vs historical-prior paired log_loss differences; circular block bootstrap independently within each external block, lengths14/60days,2000replicates,seed1701,percentile95%. Both reported, exploratory, no multiplicity correction or cure for prior inspection.
budget: 18 candidates x2inner folds=36 fits +18outerfits=54 per pass. Two passes108 fits plus24 independent outer SciPy solver checks. No search for seeds, epoch counts, horizon, thresholds or metric.
gates: Exact source/data match prior feature study
Reproduce prior fixed SGD10 metrics within1e-12
Abort on failed convergence or independent solver disagreement; do not silently drop a fit
caveats: All history already inspected, no pristine holdout claim
Early stopping may regularize: more converged train need not improve external scores
No global selection between families using external results
No PnL, costs verified, live trading, Laya, population or paid inference
